battle-boss-eclipse.where: The final battles: Warden Còr at the Umbral Spire summit, and Star-tender Fenn's post-game duel
battle-boss-eclipse.mood: The last stand on the black mountain — grand, tragic and driving: a sorrowful antagonist who wants a gentle endless night, and the light that will not go out.

battle-emberfall.where: Trainer battles: every Lampwarden duel for a Gleam (Brisa, Reyl, Sable, Otho), the Beacon and route trainers, and Wren's first friendly bout
battle-emberfall.mood: The arena duel — proud, rousing and fair: a respected challenger in the lantern-light, the fight that earns a constellation.

battle-hours.where: The Three Hours set-piece battles (Gloamber, Noctilune, Erstmorn — the legendary trio)
battle-hours.mood: Fighting a keeper of the sky's turning — awed, patient and vast, like a great clock: a jammed wheel rocking toward the next hour.

battle-main-dusk-duel.where: Every wild kin battle (the default battle bed) and the attract-mode trailer duel
battle-main-dusk-duel.mood: The fight you hear a thousand times — urgent, catchy and winnable: a minor-key chase that bursts into a heroic major lift.

battle-nightfall.where: The Hollowing's acolytes and Vigilants (incl. the summit guard), and the far-valley Lampwardens of the North and West (Mira Vael, Ysolde Frost, Lucan Pyre, Nessa Cole)
battle-nightfall.mood: The fight in the deepening dark — cold, uneasy and solemn: an enemy who believes in the gentle night, sorrow under the steel.

battle-veil.where: Rival battles with Wren (Pale Vault, Nightreach, and the post-game rematch)
battle-veil.mood: The rival who grew up beside you — cocky, quick, competitive and fond: a grin across the field, and the friendship under it.

cinderhead-mine-a.where: Cinderhead Mine (the lamplit mine-mouth town of the Lamp-down vigil)
cinderhead-mine-a.mood: Ink-black galleries where crystal veins and lamp-fire are the only light — a slow miners' hymn, melancholy but faintly warm.

cinderhead-mine-b.where: Cinderhead Lumenary (Otho Grist's hall at the mine mouth — the difficulty wall)
cinderhead-mine-b.mood: The mine under pressure — groaning timbers, charged air, a terse staccato motif over a driving low walk; held-breath tension before the wall.

cinderhead-mine-c.where: Cinderhead Deep (the three descent galleries to the old crew's vigil-lamp)
cinderhead-mine-c.mood: The deep galleries where dense crystal turns the dark luminous — a sparkle-led descent, minor warming to its relative major.

coldfog-marches-a.where: The Coldfog cluster — the drained marches, the snuffed beacon and the Hollowfen stillworks
coldfog-marches-a.mood: Snuffed — a drained marsh where the lanterns went out; a lone melody that keeps reaching for home and guttering before it gets there.

coldopen-foreboding.where: The cold-open cinematic (the Long Dusk falls; a star winks out)
coldopen-foreboding.mood: The Long Dusk falling: hushed foreboding under a sky losing its lanterns, a fragile hopeful phrase that reaches up and is never answered.

dawn-breaks.where: The ending cinematic (dawn breaks over Vesperholm)
dawn-breaks.mood: The long night ends: first light walking across every valley; the hometown lullaby finally meets the sun, radiant and tender.

dawnstead-a.where: Dawnstead — the epilogue town in the first true daylight (and the post-game festival/Còr scenes there)
dawnstead-a.mood: The lullaby in full — the hometown theme finally meeting the sun, radiant, confident and a little teary.

dimglass-coast-a.where: Dimglass Coast (the first road out of town)
dimglass-coast-a.mood: The road that teaches you to wander — brisk, salt-aired, optimistic; the hometown tune breaking into a stride.

dimglass-coast-c.where: Tideglass Cavern & Gallery (the glowing sea-caves off the Dimglass Coast) and the Lanternway Under-Lane
dimglass-coast-c.mood: Buoy-light drift — a becalmed, glittering sea-cave; the coast road's tune reduced to a glint over dripping water.

ending-credits.mood: The Road Remembered: a warm medley walking back down the whole journey in memory, every road leading home to the hometown theme in daylight.

galehigh-terraces-a.where: Galehigh Terraces (the kite-strung cliff town outdoors + the Skyloft; returns after the Kite-rising)
galehigh-terraces-a.mood: Updraft — giddy, wind-buffeted propulsion on the cliff-farms, kites snapping overhead in the last fire-light before the climb.

galehigh-terraces-b.where: Galehigh interiors — the inn, a cliff-farm home, the kite-maker's workshop, the Storm Lumenary hall
galehigh-terraces-b.mood: Lanterns on the Wind — the windy cliff seen from inside the warm farmstead at dusk: cosy, a touch wistful, the wind a sigh at the shutters.

gleam-emotional.where: Every Gleam payoff — the moment a constellation relights and the town begins to celebrate (and the dawn)
gleam-emotional.mood: Belonging, not a trophy: the motif heard in the long dusk's minor, then blooming into warm major as the sky answers.

gleam-fanfare.where: The Gleam moment — a constellation relit (played as a sting by the cutscene's gleam op)
gleam-fanfare.mood: A lantern lifted to the sky: a short triumphant fanfare that quotes the hometown motif and lands firmly home.

hushfrost-pass-a.where: Hushfrost Pass I & II (the frozen canyon route west) + the Aurora Hollow spur
hushfrost-pass-a.mood: Lamp in the Canyon — a lone lamp in a frozen canyon, the cold at your back: sparse and tender enough to keep walking, hope holding on.

lowleaf-hollow-a.where: Lowleaf Hollow (the glowmoss forest town) and Gloamwood Dell
lowleaf-hollow-a.mood: A dim-green glowmoss forest where every dewdrop catches cyan light — Lydian wonder, enchanted and curious.

lowleaf-hollow-b.where: Lowleaf's Lumenary hall, the Bower inn and Georgina's cottage; also the Pearlmoor Wanderwood and the Glowmoss Bloom arrival
lowleaf-hollow-b.mood: The safe glow at the heart of the dark forest — a lantern-lit music-box lullaby in a gentle waltz; hearth over wonder.

lowleaf-hollow-c.where: Glowmoss Deep (and its B1F), the Spore Grotto, the Sounding Cave and the Grovefall vigil site
lowleaf-hollow-c.mood: The glowing-dark deep forest — a glassy bell melody whose echoes answer across the black, sparse and cathedral-like, with a drained grey shadow in it.

nightreach-observatory-a.where: Nightreach Observatory (the star-temple town, last Lumenary, densest starfield in the game)
nightreach-observatory-a.mood: Under the Whole Sky: vast, lonely, wondrous - a single voice under every star, faint telescope clockwork, minor lifting toward major like hope dawning.

nightreach-observatory-b.where: Nightreach Lumenary (Nessa Cole's haunted hall) + the Nightreach inn and homes
nightreach-observatory-b.mood: The Haunted Lumenary: the loneliest room in Vesperholm - a minor lullaby that reaches up and never quite comes home, a clock running down; hope present but not yet earned.

pale-vault-glacier-a.where: Pale Vault Glacier (the aurora-lit ice town outdoors); returns after meeting Warden Còr and after the Aurora-watch vigil
pale-vault-glacier-a.mood: Aurora Vault — glacial, shimmering, lonely-beautiful; the stillest, most tender place in the north, suspended and never quite resolving.

pale-vault-glacier-b.where: Pale Vault interiors — the inn, a home, the Frost Lumenary hall
pale-vault-glacier-b.mood: Snow-Hushed Town — a small warm song against the cold: people and lanterns indoors, melancholy and intimate, hope that is fragile.

pale-vault-glacier-c.where: The Pale Vault Undercroft + the Hourfold (the deep-ice site of the Still Hour); returns after Noctilune is caught
pale-vault-glacier-c.mood: Glasslight — the glacier as a lush luminous reverie: ringing suspended chords, bell entries blooming and dissolving into echo; vast, sacred, still.

pearlmoor-blessing.where: The Tide-blessing festival on Pearlmoor Quay (the cutscene after the Tide Gleam is relit)
pearlmoor-blessing.mood: The going-out song — lantern boats on moonlit water; the quay waltz turned into a cool, glowing, sure ceremony.

pearlmoor-quay-b.where: Pearlmoor's outskirts — the allotment hill behind the quay and Pearlmoor Point (the Old Light headland)
pearlmoor-quay-b.mood: Low tide, lantern strings — the quay waltz late and quiet, a lonely-but-cosy sway on the edge of town.

pearlmoor-quay-c.where: The top of the Old Light on Pearlmoor Point — the joke-tower's punchline lantern room and its celebratory send-off
pearlmoor-quay-c.mood: Festival of the floating lights — the quay waltz in its happiest dress, quick, ornamented and playful.

penumbra-ring-a.where: Penumbra Ring + Starwell (the last dark before the Umbral Spire)
penumbra-ring-a.mood: Wall of Ink: the last dark, crossed on starlight; a held breath, your heartbeat and one lonely lamp-note, hope leaking in at the edges.

saltreach-fen-a.where: Saltreach Fen I (the open reed marsh east of Pearlmoor)
saltreach-fen-a.mood: A slow drift through reed shallows — a breathy woodwind wanders and the lapping water answers; melancholy, never sad.

saltreach-fen-b.where: Saltreach Fen II (the deep channels and lantern-reeds, past the Tidecall boundary)
saltreach-fen-b.mood: The same fen lonelier and further in — a boat-rocking 6/8 through bone-white mist, one questioning phrase at a time.

saltreach-fen-c.where: Sunkbell Shallows (the flooded-shrine spur off Fen II, reached by Tidecall)
saltreach-fen-c.mood: The fen relit — open water, a drowned shrine bell ringing under the ripples, a warmer lilting waltz you've earned.

sting-hour.where: The Three Hours' threshold — the moment an Hour is met, just before its set-piece battle
sting-hour.mood: A single great bell tolls the hour: deep, awed, with a long shimmering tail.

sunken-solarium-a.where: Sunken Solarium (the drowned sun-garden ruin, West) + the Old Light tower floors (Pearlmoor)
sunken-solarium-a.mood: Remembered Summer: stored daylight glowing up through the water - warm, nostalgic, everything in the past tense; the first real warmth since the south.

sunken-solarium-b.where: Sunken Solarium Lumenary (Lucan Pyre's flooded stage hall) + the Last-Warm-Day festival bed
sunken-solarium-b.mood: Drowned Halls: the same sun-garden with the water winning - cooler, lonelier, a summer theme recoloured into its relative minor; bittersweet warmth spent knowing it fades.

sunken-solarium-c.where: The Unrisen Stair (Three Hours site III, the Dawn-that-waited) + after its catch + the Old Light's 5th floor
sunken-solarium-c.mood: Sunsketch Bloom: the relit reading - daylight surging back into the drowned garden, the motif sung twice and the second time brighter; the score reaching toward dawn.

sunvault-climb-a.where: Sunvault Climb I & II (golden vine terraces up to Nightreach) + the Sunfall vigil site
sunvault-climb-a.mood: Vines to the Sky: warm, ascending, hopeful - every phrase climbs like the terraces; the sunniest route in the West.

sunvault-climb-c.where: Helia Vault (the Sunsketch puzzle reliquary off Sunvault Climb II)
sunvault-climb-c.mood: First Light at the Top: Solar warmth meets the first true starlight - the climbing hook at its highest, doubled in bells, inside a sunlit reliquary of blooms and sun-mirrors.

tinderwick-a.mood: The hometown lullaby — lanterns in the dark, cosy and a little homesick. The source of the Vesper motif.

tinderwick-b.where: Tinderwick indoors — the apprentice's home and the village store
tinderwick-b.mood: Embers banked low — the hometown lullaby gone indoors at night, a 6/8 sway by the coals, homesick and safe.

tinderwick-c.where: Duskapple Orchard — Tinderwick's old orchard through the west hedge (the satchel errand, the fallen-star crater)
tinderwick-c.mood: First light on the water — the hometown tune's rising half asked under orchard boughs, Lydian wonder with a thread of mystery.

title.mood: The calling card: a lone lantern-tune in the dark explodes into a heroic minor adventure anthem; the Long Dusk, and the journey rising against it.

umbral-spire-a.where: Umbral Spire summit (the Great Null, Warden Còr, the Keystar)
umbral-spire-a.mood: Crown of Null: the summit under the Keystar; grave, sorrowful grandeur and driving resolve, the hometown motif boomed in minor and promised its major.

umbral-spire-b.where: Umbral Spire ascent (gatehouse, null-works, high gallery)
umbral-spire-b.mood: The Black Ascent: the climb through the dead Lumenary, null-lanterns leaking anti-light; relentless minor drive, all tension and no release.

umbral-spire-c.where: Umbral Spire summit, the Keystar relight cutscene
umbral-spire-c.mood: First True Dawn: the Keystar catches and the whole sky lights; the hometown motif stated whole in radiant major, triumphant with a tear in it.

windward-stair-a.where: Windward Stair I & II (the switchback mountain route) + the Wind-Eye and Thunderroost spurs
windward-stair-a.mood: The Long Climb — airy, building, breath-quickening; each phrase re-launches a step higher so the loop feels like ascent.
